About Mdcat Prime

Mdcat Prime is a student-focused educational platform created to make MDCAT preparation structured, accessible, and effective for Pakistani pre-medical students.

Mdcat Prime

Mdcat Prime is an online practice platform built for students preparing for medical and dental college entry tests in Pakistan. It brings chapter-wise practice for Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English and Logical Reasoning together in one simple place, so you can prepare with a clear routine instead of scattered material.

Chapter-Wise Practice

Preparation is organised chapter by chapter, so you can focus on one topic at a time and build your understanding step by step.

Mock Tests

Complete exam-style papers that bring questions from every subject together, so you can sit a full practice exam in one go and review your performance afterwards.

Instant Results & Review

As soon as you finish a test, you can see your result and review every question to learn from your mistakes.

Made for Students

Everything here is designed around a student's routine — simple to use, easy to follow, and centred on steady, focused preparation.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. Mdcat Prime only collects the basic account details you provide when you register, and uses them to run your account and keep your practice activity connected to you.

We do not sell your personal information to anyone. If this policy changes in the future, the updated version will be published on this page.

Terms & Conditions

By using Mdcat Prime, you agree to the following terms:

Educational purpose: All tests and materials are provided for educational and practice purposes only. While we strive for accuracy, we do not guarantee that all questions reflect the exact MDCAT exam.

Acceptable use: You agree to use the platform for personal educational purposes. You may not scrape, copy, or redistribute test content without permission.

Accounts: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account. Provide accurate information when registering.

Changes: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

Privacy Policy

Mdcat Prime (mdcatprep-seven.vercel.app) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using Mdcat Prime, you agree to the practices described below.

Last updated: 29 October 2026

1. Information We Collect

When you register or take a test, we collect your name, email address, and test responses. We also collect basic technical information automatically when you visit the site, such as your device type, browser type, and pages you visit, which helps us keep the platform working and improve it.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used solely to provide test services, create and manage your account, track your performance, display your results, and improve the platform. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

3. Cookies

Mdcat Prime uses cookies and similar technologies. Essential ones keep you signed in and keep the site secure. Preference ones remember your settings, such as your theme. Mdcat Prime does not use analytics cookies or advertising cookies. You can control cookies through your browser settings, but blocking essential ones may prevent parts of the site, such as login, from working.

4. Third-Party Services

We use trusted third-party services to operate Mdcat Prime, including Firebase (Google) for secure storage of your account and test data. These services process data only as needed to provide their functionality and are governed by their own privacy policies.

5. Data Security & Retention

We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We retain your account and test data while your account is active. If you want your data removed, contact us through the Contact page.

6. Children’s Privacy

Mdcat Prime is an educational platform for MDCAT preparation and is not directed at children under 13. Users under 18 should use the platform with the permission of a parent or guardian.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the “Last updated” date above. Continued use of the platform after changes means you accept the updated policy.

8. Contact Us

If you have questions about this policy or want your data removed, contact us through the Contact page.
